name: Medical cash allowance to dependants

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 11-2018 (and RR 4-2025 for uniforms and achievement awards, from 30 January 2025) (c): medical cash allowance to dependants to ₱1,500 a semester (₱250 a month): a de minimis benefit to the semester ceiling (January–June, July–December), the excess inside the ₱90,000 exclusion — the DE_MINIMIS_DEPENDANT_MEDICAL checkpoint. The per-month figure is the semester's sixth, so the semester ceiling governs either cadence.

name: Laundry allowance

references.title: RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3) as amended by RR 11-2018 (and RR 4-2025 for uniforms and achievement awards, from 30 January 2025) (g): laundry allowance to ₱300 a month: a de minimis benefit to the ceiling in each calendar month, the excess inside the ₱90,000 exclusion — the DE_MINIMIS_LAUNDRY checkpoint.
